Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement cadence: our procurement team requires a completed order form + commercial terms BEFORE we issue a PO. Legal can sign the MSA and DPA in parallel, but procurement will not create a PO until the order form lists final SKU/pricing and payment terms.

2) Data scope: we will likely need the DPA signed before any PHI touches your environment for the pilot. Security wants the SOC 2 snapshot and the questionnaire answers (we'll send a short list).

3) Legal redlines: our outside counsel (copied) prefers to work from an MSA baseline. If you can share a clean MSA draft instead of the MPA PDF redline, we can speed the review.

Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts a two-step signature — MSA+DPA first, order form to follow — or whether you need order form lines to be present to pull pricing/quoting?

Anita
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Blueframe Therapeutics

Hi Anita — looping in sequencing recommendations so procurement and legal have visibility.

Short answer: Redwood is comfortable with a two-step flow (MSA + DPA first; order form finalized within 10 business days after signatures) for pilot projects where a PO is not required to begin technical work. For customers that insist on PO-first, we can prioritize order form pricing lines up front and lock pricing via an order form in parallel to legal review — tradeoff is more upfront procurement dependency.

Proposed sequencing (recommended for Blueframe):
- Day 0: Share a clean MSA draft (we will upload a non-redlined baseline to the Drive) and the DPA template
- Day 1–7: Security Q&A + SOC 2 evidence collection (Laura & Security SME to own)
- Day 4–10: Legal redlines (parallel review; Karthik will triage commercial requests)
- Day 8–12: MSA + DPA signature window; order form finalization immediately after

Owner assignments:
- Redwood legal owner: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.ai) — he'll coordinate redlines and escalation
- Security evidence: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.ai) — will provide answers and the evidence bundle
- Mutual action plan (task owner + dates): Aditya Rao (aditya_rao@redwood.ai) to maintain and update HubSpot MPA and share the live link

I uploaded a clean MSA baseline and a suggested order form template to the shared folder (link below). Please confirm whether your procurement requires a signed order form before issuing a PO; if so we will prepare the order form fields today.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_shared/blueframe-mpa

Thanks — happy to run a quick 20-min aligning call this afternoon if helpful.
